candidates.description: This vector represents international relations, treaties, and conflicts between nations.
This vector represents legal or institutional rules concerning permissions, prohibitions, and regulations.
This vector represents financial and macroeconomic concepts related to money, debt, and taxation.
This feature vector represents adverbs that quantify, qualify, or restrict the scope, frequency, or intent of actions and statements.
This vector represents organized human social groups, entities, and collectives.
This feature vector activates on titles, nobility, and religious figures associated with leadership, growth, and historical or spiritual eminence.
This vector represents major life events and milestones related to family, relationships, and human development.
This vector is related to quantitative measurement, statistics, and numerical evaluation.
This vector represents legislative and governmental institutions, political systems, and constitutional authority.
This vector represents the concept of social status, relational standing, and emotional or formal commitment between entities.
